svg.text: Life node v1 - low-profile field mount
Sits inside a standing crop. Nothing stands above 1090 mm: the microphone and the 4G antenna are both inside the box. All dimensions in mm.
A Side elevation, from the east
standing crop
grade
to probes, 3 m
100 Wp panel at 40° south. Doubles as the
box's sunshade and rain cap
microphone port: 5 mm hole, acoustic
membrane behind it, foam hood over it
4G stick radiates through the plastic wall.
No external antenna, no mast
IP65 box 300 x 200 x 130, base 500 up
60 x 60 post, 800 driven. No concrete
probe cable in a 120 slit, turf closed over
B Front elevation, from the south
panel 1010 x 510

3 x M20 gland on the underside, one vented. Mic port in the wall.
Nothing enters from above.
Volume used is 45%, but the battery must lie flat and takes
55% of the floor: 43 mm headroom above it. Measure before drilling.
What the in-box design costs
Power: survivable. December is the tight month and also the bare-field
month, so the panel is unshaded exactly when it matters. A summer canopy
cuts it to roughly 80 Wh/day against a 50 Wh load, which is why the panel
is 100 Wp and not 50.
Sound: a capsule at 500 mm behind a membrane hears a smaller circle than
one on a mast, and crop rustle sits closer to it. That is the real price of
this design. It buys a 10 cm I2S run instead of an impossible 1500 mm one,
one cable and one gland fewer, and nothing at all sticking up.
4G: the stick radiates through the plastic wall for a few dB of loss. The
steel mounting plate is what would ruin it, so it does not go in the box.
Wind: the panel is a 0.5 m2 sail. At 25 m/s it pushes about 170 N sideways, and
raising the box from 300 to 500 mm lifts the overturning moment from roughly
120 to 155 Nm. That is why the post is driven 800 rather than 600.
D Probe trench, section
cable, 120 deep slit
probe 1 -100
probe 2 -300
Probes 3 m from the post so the post's shadow and drip line do not bias the readings.
Theft: matt green throughout, no reflective labels, no branding, cable lock through post and enclosure lugs. Machinery: a box this low is invisible to a sprayer too, so
log the position on the farmer's own GPS and site it on a headland or beside a tramline rather than mid-crop.
